get.description: Returns a greeting string indicating the backend service is running.
get.summary: System health check and welcome endpoint

post.description: Registers a new user record. Roles can be customer, provider, manager, or admin.

400.description: Invalid payload or email already exists.

get.description: Retrieves all registered users without sensitive password fields.
Retrieves a single user document by its MongoDB ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates specific fields on an existing user.

delete.description: Permanently removes a user record from the system.

post.description: Creates a new provider document linked to a User, specifying offered services, work hours, working days, and GeoJSON location.
post.summary: Create / register a service provider profile

get.description: Retrieves all service providers with user relations, working days, and status.
Retrieves a single service provider profile by Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates provider fields such as status, offered services, work hours, or location.

delete.description: Removes a provider profile from the platform.

post.description: Creates a manager record linked to a User, with salary, experience, and office GeoLocation.

get.description: Retrieves all managers with populated user info and active status.
Retrieves a single manager by its Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates manager status (active, suspended, inactive), salary, or office location.

post.description: Registers a serviceable geographical region assigned to a regional manager with centroid coordinates.

get.description: Retrieves all operational regions with their assigned manager and centroid locations.
Retrieves a single region document by Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates region properties, such as assigned manager, centroid GeoLocation, or active state.

delete.description: Removes a region from the platform.

post.description: Creates a service category with name, description, image URL, and active status.

get.description: Retrieves all service categories in the platform catalog.
Retrieves a single service category by Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates category title, description, thumbnail image, or active status.

delete.description: Removes a category from the catalog.

post.description: Creates a service offering with pricing in paise, duration in minutes, what is covered/not covered, how it works, and FAQs.

get.description: Retrieves all service offerings populated with category data.
Retrieves a single service offering by its Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates price, duration, descriptions, FAQs, or active availability.

delete.description: Deletes a service offering from the catalog.

post.description: Creates a checkout order record snapshotting address and total amount in paise, with a 15-minute expiration timestamp.

get.description: Retrieves all orders, populated with customer profile data.
Retrieves single order details by its Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates order status (e.g. paid, failed, refunded) or associated fields.

delete.description: Removes an order document from the database.

post.description: Creates a booking reservation for a service with provider, customer, scheduledDate, startTime/endTime, travel buffers, and fee splits.

400.description: Invalid booking data or slot conflict.

get.description: Retrieves all bookings with populated service, provider, customer, order, and region references.
Retrieves a single booking details by its Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates booking state (e.g. confirmed, in_progress, completed, cancelled), OTP, or notes.

delete.description: Removes a booking record from the platform.

post.description: Creates a payment record linked to an Order, total amount in paise, currency, and Razorpay order ID.

get.description: Retrieves all payment transactions populated with order data.
Retrieves a single payment transaction by its Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates payment status, Razorpay payment ID, method, or refund details.

delete.description: Removes a payment record from the database.

post.description: Creates a 1-5 star review and optional comment for a completed booking, linking the provider and service.

400.description: Invalid review payload or duplicate booking review.

post.summary: Submit a service review and rating

get.description: Retrieves all reviews with populated booking, provider, and service details.
Retrieves a single review by its Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates review rating or text comment.

delete.description: Removes a customer review from the system.

post.description: Blocks out a provider schedule on a specific date between startTime and endTime (in minutes from midnight).

400.description: Invalid time bounds or missing fields.

get.description: Retrieves all blackout periods populated with provider profiles.
Retrieves a single unavailability record by its Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates date, time slot bounds, or reason on an existing unavailability record.

delete.description: Deletes a blackout period, freeing the provider calendar slot.

post.description: Creates system-wide configuration including commission percentage, max assignment distance, slot intervals, lead times, and timeouts.

get.description: Retrieves all configuration entries for platform policies and scheduling constraints.
Retrieves a specific configuration document by Mongo ObjectId.

patch.description: Updates commission fee percent, slot interval, buffer times, or offer timeout limits.

info.title: Tatku United - Digital Services Marketplace API
info.description: Complete RESTful API documentation for Tatku United: an on-demand digital & home services scheduling and fulfillment platform. Includes all domain resources: Users, Providers, Managers, Regions, Categories, Services, Orders, Bookings, Payments, Reviews, Unavailability, and Platform Settings.
